text: The School of Law offers courses to law majors and sees to the ideological and political education to students of the whole university. Among the 60 teachers of the school, there are 20 professors and associate professors, 13 PhDs; besides, most of the full-time teachers are MA degrees holders. In recent years, the school has published around 300 theses in various journals, 40 treatises, and participated in more than 10 research projects above provincial level have been. B.A. Law Objectives: This program aims to qualify students as senior experts systemically master legal knowledge, Chinese law and related policies. Objects: Four- year Bachelor of Law Degree Main courses: Jurisprudence, History of Chinese legal systems, Constitution, Administrative Law and Administrative Procedure Law, Civil Law, Commercial Law, Economic Law, Criminal Law, Criminal Procedure Law, Labor Law, Environmental Law, Civil Procedure Law, International Law, International Private Law and International Economic Law.
